PLAY · CLUE READING

Raccoon’s Clue Hunt

Read the clues, then tap the object they describe!

A wheel, handlebars, and a bell. What object is this?

A long neck, four legs, and patches. Who is this?

A smiley face, two hands, and numbers in a circle. What is this?

Clue hunt complete!

A bicycle, a giraffe, and a clock — the clues never lied.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Clue hunts ask the earliest inference: parts that add up to a whole. Name each clue, then wonder together — "what has all of those?"

Prefer paper? The Raccoon’s Clue Hunt worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
